differential.name: Diabetic nephropathy (diabetic kidney disease)
differential.rationale: Long‑standing type 2 diabetes with proteinuria, microalbuminuria, CKD stages 2‑4 and high creatinine consistent with diabetic ESRD.

differential.name: Hypertensive nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Co‑existing essential hypertension and CKD progression; common cause of CKD in obese middle‑aged adults.

differential.name: Chronic glomerulonephritis (e.g., IgA nephropathy)
differential.rationale: Persistent proteinuria and CKD without clear alternative; could contribute to progressive renal loss.

differential.name: Acute kidney injury superimposed on CKD (e.g., volume depletion, nephrotoxic drug)
differential.rationale: Slightly elevated potassium and low CO₂ suggest possible acute tubular injury on chronic disease.

differential.name: Obstructive uropathy (e.g., renal calculi, stricture)
differential.rationale: Less likely but can cause CKD progression; considered given lack of imaging data.
